name: elongation factor like GTPase 1

function.text: EFL1 encodes elongation factor-like GTPase 1. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and GTP binding. It participates in GTP metabolic process and cytosolic ribosome assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Shwachman-Diamond syndrome 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
